title: Christmas Cranberry Rosemary Spritz
description: A cranberry and orange sparkling wine cocktail for Christmas.
author: Better Sweet Drinks
ingredients: 4 oz chilled Prosecco or other sparkling wine
Ice, 1 rosemary sprig, orange slice and fresh cranberries
instructions:
1. Combine cranberry and orange juices in a wine glass; add syrup to taste.
  2. Add ice and slowly pour in sparkling wine. Stir once.
  3. Garnish with rosemary, orange and cranberries.
notes: Prepare one serving at a time. Add sparkling ingredients only when ready to serve.
